findings.issue: Previously, tool calls from Copilot did not mutate client-side Zustand stores directly, leading to UI/Store desynchronization where doctor saw an action confirmed but odontogram and diary remained empty.
findings.fix: Built aiActionDispatcher.ts and wired it directly into useCopilot.ts (tool_result event & confirm handler) and copilotActionRunner.ts, synchronously mutating useVisitStore and useAppStore.

findings.issue: Destructive actions (such as tooth extraction, record deletion, appointment cancellation) could either execute implicitly or block the user in nested modal dead-ends.
findings.fix: Enforced Mandate 8e Doctor Autonomy: isDestructiveAction automatically tags destructive actions as requiring 1-click confirmation without blocking the UI, while safe clinical actions auto-apply smoothly.

findings.issue: Offline resilience: when backend LLM experienced 429 quota or connection drop, copilot would stall indefinitely with empty messages or spinners.
findings.fix: Integrated copilotFallbackRouter on backend and local regex/semantic fallback in aiAssistantService on web client so the doctor always receives instant responses and actions even when offline.
